notes: LUMEN: a first-person descent into a bioluminescent cave system. Collect 8 crystals, avoid 8 patrolling Shades, stun them with a resonance pulse. Features pointer-lock FPS controls with AABB collision, sprint/stamina, health pickups, positional Web Audio, bloom post-processing, adaptive quality, gamepad and touch support, settings persistence, and win/lose/restart loop. Known limitations: requires network for Three.js CDN; touch controls are basic; no save of in-progress run beyond best time.
